sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report details fraudulent online transactions conducted using card C05851-K1 issued to customer C05851. On 2016-11-21 between 10:00:00 and 10:30:00, four online purchases were executed via the online channel using device profile C6743 Build/LMY47V | Android 5.1.1 | android browser 4.0 | 960x540. The transactions were structured to stay just under the $500 threshold, with amounts of $459.27, $496.35, $468.22, and $488.00, totaling $1,911.84. This activity is highly suspicious because the varying amounts were clearly chosen to evade thresholds, and the exact device profile was used exclusively for these structured transactions. Furthermore, the same structuring pattern appears on 11 other cards (C00466-K1, C01890-K1, C02265-K1, C03633-K1, C05423-K1, C05766-K1, C06881-K1, C07297-K1, C10751-K1, C10990-K1, and C12641-K2) in the surrounding 30 days, pointing to a coordinated shared-device ring. The total exposure amounts to $1,911.84. Initial and final fraud probabilities were assessed at 0.97. Actions taken include automatic case creation, automatic escalation to an analyst under policy R9 for an undocumented coordinated pattern, automatic monitoring of connected cards under policy R6, a recommended and pending approval action to block the card under policy 6, and a recommended and pending approval action to file a report under policy 3a, R6, and R9.
